listing.name: Tekken 6 — Tekken 6 Native Online (Ekspym)
listing.summary: The project describes native matches, lobby and rollback, but does not establish a campaign. It credits mahmoud-mess for faster recompiled code; reuse does not establish the same runtime owner. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA or European Rev1 Xbox 360 ISO or extracted folder. The builder rejects other versions.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the v2.4.2 release launcher to generate code and compile locally for x64 D3D12. Source is available at Ekspym/tekken6-native-online-source.

warnings: The project describes native matches, lobby and rollback, but does not establish a campaign. It credits mahmoud-mess for faster recompiled code; reuse does not establish the same runtime owner.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
